notes: §2002:13.16.14.3 GR12: COLUMNS 1 5 9 prints the same line as its OCCURS 3 STEP 4 equivalent (§2002:13.16.36.3 GR12a). COLUMNS 1 4 10 takes three SOURCE operands at unequal intervals (§2002:13.16.51.3 GR4) and leaves the horizontal counter at 11, so COLUMN PLUS 2 prints at 13. The --std 2002 run matched the derived lines.
